title: dpa-art28 native sidecar 1.0
description: Structural record of one dpa-art28 run (review/draft/redline/JCA): which instrument, which router mode, the Art. 28(3)(a)-(h) coverage checklist, Annex 2 (TOM) presence/assessment, transfer-tier Clause-section integrity, and the outcome recommendation. Companion to SKILL.md's per-mode output structure (the human deliverable) — this does not restructure that deliverable, it is the machine-checkable summary of it.

id.description: Session-assigned stable identifier for the contract/instrument being reviewed or drafted (not a legal document number).

tier.description: Tier 1 Commercial / Tier 2 Strict / Tier 3 Hybrid (references/tier-selection.md). Only meaningful for DRAFT/REDLINE, or REVIEW_* of a 2021/915-based instrument.

art28_coverage.description: The Art. 28(3)(a)-(h) coverage table (SKILL.md REVIEW_QUICK output item 2 / REVIEW_NEG Annex review).

annex2_toms.description: Contractual sufficiency of the Annex 2 (TOMs) annex — NOT its substantive appropriateness, which is toms-art32's assessment (SKILL.md 'Out of scope').

toms_art32_assessed.description: Whether the annex's substance has actually been confirmed by a toms-art32 run (as opposed to merely present as boilerplate).

sections_intact.description: For a 2021/915-incorporated instrument: whether Sections I, II and III of the Clauses remain unmodified (Clause 2(a) bars replacing any Section; v1.4 fixed a defect where Tier 3 dropped Section III).

ropa_relevant.description: Whether this run's processing activities are ones the organisation's RoPA (Art. 30) should reflect. dpa-art28 never assesses RoPA itself (SKILL.md 'Out of scope') — this flag only signals whether the topic came up.
